title: Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage Claim Payment Standards: Repairs, Payees and Incidental Items
content:
## Payment standard

1. A repair payment under Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage is issued only after the claim is accepted. A claim payment is issued only when the latest coverage decision on the claim is accepted; the decision is read from the claim file, not from the customer's account of it.
2. The first repair payment pays the original estimate less the deductible (net of Deductible Rewards credit). Each supplement is paid in full as its own payment, and a supplement at or above the option's reinspection figure (1500.00 USD on every option) is reinspected before payment.
3. When every estimate version together is at or below the deductible, nothing is paid and the claim closes below deductible.
4. At a Cardinal Select Shop the payment goes to the shop and the repair carries the Select Shop workmanship warranty (lifetime, while the vehicle is owned). Elsewhere the payment goes to the insured at the prevailing competitive labor rate in the garaging area, and a repair payment at or above the joint-payee figure (2500.00 USD on every option) on a vehicle with a loss payee names the loss payee jointly.
5. Original manufacturer parts are used on vehicles of the option's stated number of model years or newer; driver-assistance calibration is paid (every option pays it).
6. Towing from the scene is paid up to the option's towing miles. Storage is paid up to the option's daily storage maximum through the stated number of days after the storage notice. Veterinary bills of a dog or cat injured in a covered collision are paid up to the option's pet injury limit without a deductible. Aftermarket custom equipment is paid up to the option's custom equipment limit.
7. A payment that was issued in error, or that is returned uncashed, is voided and reissued as a new payment.

## Payee at a glance

| Repair shop | Loss payee on the vehicle | Repair payment amount | Made out to |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Select Shop | Any | Any | The shop |
| Outside the network | None | Any | The insured |
| Outside the network | Yes | Below 2500.00 | The insured |
| Outside the network | Yes | 2500.00 or more | The insured and the loss payee jointly |

## Worked illustration (hypothetical figures, no Deductible Rewards credit)

A collision claim is accepted with a deductible of 500.00. The original estimate is 3200.00 at a shop outside the network, and the vehicle has a lienholder as loss payee.
- First repair payment: 3200.00 less 500.00 gives 2700.00. It is at or above 2500.00, so the lienholder is named jointly with the insured.
- A supplement of 1600.00 follows: it is at or above 1500.00, so it is reinspected before payment and then paid in full, 1600.00, as its own payment.

Had the only estimate been 450.00 against the same 500.00 deductible, the estimate would be at or below the deductible: nothing is paid and the claim closes below deductible.
